column1: # The domain backup key (the domain backup key contract): root_key (hex of 32 bytes), backup_key_rev → the key in hex.
# HMAC-SHA256(root_key, "w2c domain backup secrets" 0x00 ‖ ASCII backup_key_rev). Form — README.

column5: ASCII of the decimal notation without leading zeros: «10», two bytes
backup_key_rev 0 — not a key: an integer ≥ 1
a notation with a leading zero — not backup_key_rev
backup_key_rev 2^53 − 1 — the top of the domain pos53
backup_key_rev 2^53 — outside the domain: a refusal of the derivation (DBK-G01)
root_key in capitals A–F — reads, the key is the same (DBK-G02)
